newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ACT venture capital invests 1.65 mln punts in ICR.
newsitem.headline: ACT venture capital invests 1.65 mln punts in ICR.

text.p: Irish ACT Venture Capital has invested 1.65 million Irish pounds for a 25 percent stake in Irish Car Rentals (ICR), ACT said in a statement on Tursday.
ICR said the ACT funds would go into planned growth and expansion in both the car rental and dealership business.
ICR was established in 1984 with its headquarters in Limerick and has operations in Dublin and Cork, employing over 100 people.
The company, one of six short term car rental companies in Ireland, expects its 1997 turnover to exceed 15 million Irish pounds.
